sources.snippet: Dense 27B decode is bandwidth-bound on all 27B active params (vs 3B for 35B-MoE): ~1.6 TB/s ÷ 27 GB ≈ 60 tok/s theoretical peak at FP8. Measured 47 tok/s is ~78% efficiency, typical for FP8 tensor-core kernels on Blackwell SM_120.

sources.snippet: This example runs Qwen3.6-35B (UD-Q6_K quantization) on Jetson Orin with llama.cpp and exposes an OpenAI-compatible API server. Hardware Requirement: This model requires an AGX Orin 64G module (or equivalent 64GB system memory).
